title: Bruker
summary: US maker of scientific instruments including mass spectrometry, NMR and microscopy.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Bruker sells mass spectrometers, nuclear magnetic resonance systems, X-ray instruments and microscopes for life-science, materials and semiconductor research. Its tools are used in structural biology, drug discovery and materials characterisation, and it has a growing cryogenic and quantum-instrumentation line. Research funding and lab capex drive results.

Technology Exposure

  • Mass spectrometry and NMR
  • X-ray and microscopy instruments
  • Cryogenic and quantum instrumentation

What To Watch

  • Academic and pharma research funding
  • China demand
  • Instrument replacement cycles

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
